author: Ainy Cormac
description:
The Fall of Hyperion by Dan Simmons is the follow up to his 1989, Hugo and Locus award-winning Hyperion. The second in the Hyperion Cantos, The Fall of Hyperion is in many ways the moment Dan Simmons reveals the true scale of his ambition.
